name: Laird
summary: At Auberdine's inn, Laird sells fish and cooking supplies to travelers along Darkshore's coast.

sections.title: A Harbor Merchant
sections.body: Inside Auberdine's inn, Laird sells fish and supplies. Sailors, locals, and travelers come to him as Darkshore's waters churn with dangers greater than those along Teldrassil's sheltered shores. Yet anglers willing to cast from the misty beaches can earn a handsome profit from the local catch.

sections.title: Ties Across the Water
sections.body: Laird keeps in touch with fishing operations across the channel in Teldrassil. His fellow fisher Nessa Shadowsong sends shipments from Rut'theran Village, linking it with the mainland port and keeping coastal trade moving.

faq.answer: Find Laird on the ground floor of Auberdine's inn. Auberdine is the main Alliance settlement on Darkshore's coast.
Laird sells caught fish and cooking ingredients. He also teaches how to prepare a Fillet of Frenzy.
Laird receives a delivery from Nessa Shadowsong at Rut'theran Village. Then he asks adventurers to carry word back across the sea.

faq.q: Why does Laird think Darkshore fishing is worthwhile despite the danger?
faq.answer: Darkshore's misty shoreline is more dangerous than Teldrassil's tranquil waters. Yet its abundant and exotic sea life can make fishing more profitable for enterprising fishers.

angles.text: If you travel through Darkshore to cook, Laird teaches you to fillet and cook the fierce frenzy fish found in Kalimdor's waters.
As a night elf, you can see how your people trade along Kalimdor's mainland shores and support the growing coastal network through Laird.
